_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 04 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain wires the two GRN Vue views (mobile-optimised create form + detail) onto custom manifest pages. The form captures multi-PO receipts with per-line received/accepted/rejected quantities + rejection reason + carrier + delivery-note ref + delivery-condition photos. The detail view drives the quality-check and accept transitions — the latter posts a StockMove credit for every accepted line (movementType=receipt, movementReason=normal, referenceDocumentUri=shillinq://purchase-order/<poId>) and updates the originating PO(s) lifecycle to partial_received / fully_received. Registered as kind=page custom components in src/registry.js.
